items.title: Stanley Dance interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 12, 1998
items.q: There’s a new book called The History of Jazz by Ted Gioia.

ctx.x: I like that word “ambitious” that you just used.

Well it is, isn’t it? Even today. There’s a new book called The History of Jazz by Ted Gioia. Well the first half of it takes you up to the end of the Swing Era and I can understand that, and he’s done a good job. Then when he goes into the rest of the history of jazz, you get bebop, but the later period it seems as though you could do anything and if it’s different, it’s good. But that’s not true you know.
If it’s new then it’s justifiable.
